name: python-on-path
label: Python 3
description: Python 3 is runnable — as python3 or python on Unix, as py -3 or python on Windows.

commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User') + ';' + $env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Microsoft\WindowsApps'; $base = @('install','--id','Python.Python.3.12','-e','--silent','--accept-package-agreements','--accept-source-agreements','--disable-interactivity'); $src = @('--source','winget'); $scp = @('--scope','user'); $srcErr = @(-1978335138,-1978335210,-1978335163,-1978335157); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($srcErr -contains $c) { $src = @(); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($c -eq -1978335216) { $scp = @(); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($c -eq -1978335189) { winget @base @src @scp --force; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($null -eq $c) { exit 1 }; exit $c

commands.darwin: for c in python3 python; do p="$(command -v $c 2>/dev/null)" || continue; if [ "$p" = /usr/bin/python3 ] || [ "$p" = /usr/bin/python ]; then d="$(xcode-select -p 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$d" ] && [ -x "$d/usr/bin/$c" ] || continue; fi; v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.linux: for c in python3 python; do v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); foreach ($c in @('py','python')) { if (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $a = @(); if ($c -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; $v = & $c @a --version 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and [string]$v -match '^Python 3') { exit 0 } } }; exit 1
